slides.title: New to Laval? 5 woods to try this winter
slides.sub: Picking a sector? Check its green space first. These 5 have trails open all winter.

photo.credit: Bois Papineau, Duvernay · Photo: Richard Mc Neil, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.title: Duvernay: Bois Papineau
slides.body: On boulevard Saint-Martin East, with **free parking**. Open year round, leashed dogs welcome.

slides.title: Bois de l'Équerre: 12.95 km of trails
slides.body: On rang de l'Équerre, near boulevard Dagenais. **Snowshoe rentals** in winter.

slides.title: Sainte-Rose: a river park in winter

photo.credit: Sainte-Rose-de-Lima church · Photo: Pierre5018, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.body: Parc de la Rivière-des-Mille-Îles: enter on rue Hotte, behind this church. **13 km** of trails, free snowshoe loans.
slides.source: Per Parc de la Rivière-des-Mille-Îles, November 2026

slides.title: Laval-des-Rapides: Parc Bernard-Landry
slides.body: On boulevard des Prairies. Cross-country skiing, sledding and skating in winter, **disc golf** year round.
slides.source: Per Tourisme Laval and Ville de Laval, November 2026

slides.title: West end: Bois Sainte-Dorothée

photo.credit: Bois Sainte-Dorothée · Photo: Hubert Figuière, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.body: Off rue du Mont-Laval. **6 km** of winter trails for snowshoeing or cross-country skiing.
slides.source: Per Tourisme Laval and Sortir au Québec, November 2026

slides.title: Moving to Laval? Ask me about any sector.
slides.tagline: Let's break this down together. No rush.
